name: M4U-mini
description:
M4U: Evaluating Multilingual Understanding and Reasoning for Large Multimodal Models
	

[Webpage] [Paper] [Huggingface Dataset] [Leaderboard]

	
		
		🎨 M4U-mini
	

To support more languages, we have constructed a tiny version of M4U with three additional languages (Japanese, Arabic, and Thai). We randomly selected 5% of the test data and follow our processing pipeline to construct these parts. We plan to expand M4U to include these medium or low-resource languages and more disciplines… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/M4U-Benchmark/M4U-mini.
reputation: M4U (and the M4U-mini subset) is a recently introduced multilingual multimodal benchmark that is gaining attention for evaluating cross-lingual reasoning in vision+language models.
